name: zmodel_fog_set_height_high
description: zModel fog height-high setter stores the new high height and updates the cached reciprocal height range only when the new height range is nonzero.
known_limits: Tier C only; no reviewed VC COFF byte comparison has been accepted, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x476220 validates computing heightHigh - gModel_FogHeightLow, storing heightHigh to gModel_FogHeightHigh, comparing the computed range against zero, preserving gModel_FogHeightInvRange for a zero range, and otherwise storing 1.0f / range to gModel_FogHeightInvRange before ret 4.
Native smoke zmodel_fog_set_height_high_smoke verifies positive nonzero range reciprocal update, zero range reciprocal preservation, negative nonzero range reciprocal update, and high-height storage.
